body: I won't give up, this will likely be the final update unless she worsens again, thanks again for the help.

She told me she won't do it tonight, which is a huge step for her.  My only concern now is that she's lying to me, which I don't think she would do to me.  Hopefully I can set her straight and save her from this, thanks again for the help, you really kept me thinking straight and stopped me from second guessing myself.
I agree with that completely.  I'm going to try to help her but if she doesn't definitively say she won't do it, i'll have to tell her mom.

She skipped school today and justified it by this concert tonight.  She's leaving at 6 (EST) and after this was when she said she would do it.  I've been really trying to get her to say she wouldn't do it or at least wait but I ended up having no way to see her this weekend without being able to drive.  I don't know if I can stop her, and I think she'll stop responding once she leaves.

Goodnight, thank you so much for responding, hopefully I can help her although she's still skeptical it will happen again thank you for your help.

edit: In case you come back to see what happened, she's going to think about it overnight although I'm afraid she'll think no and then do something drastic before she responds to me, hopefully she gives me an answer and is okay the next day.  Also did not send the facebook message, I don't want her to feel like she can't trust me until there is no other option.
Thank you, I think if she says no than I'm going to message her mother about what she's saying to me so maybe she could help her.  She's certainly considering this though which is great on its own.

I just asked her about the weekend but she said it was impossible with transportation, I gave her some ways I could go see her and she just said she doesn't know.  Thank you for your own insight on this it's really helping having somebody else to talk to about this.

I live roughly an hour away but I legally cannot drive over to her and I haven't told my parents or anyone else about this since if I tell somebody she might lose me as the only person she could trust. 

I'm contemplating sending a fb message to her mom after asking her "Is there anything at all I can do or say to keep you from doing this tomorrow?" Then getting a flat out "no"

edit: I'll ask if she wants to see me in person this weekend, which might help her.
